Total Lead Deaths Since the Start of condor Reintroduction From 1992 through 2024 there have been 151 deaths from lead poisoning in the wild free flying population. Lead poisoning is responsible for 49% percent of 308 deaths with a known cause and 28% of 534 total deaths.
